A '''xenopsychiatrist''' was a [[Doctor/Legends|physician]] whose specialty was the treatment of mental disorders suffered by [[Sentience/Legends|sentient beings]] of all [[Species/Legends|species]]. Doctor [[Thalleus Tharn]] was a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] xenopsychiatrist and [[Brain/Legends|brain]] surgeon who served as the [[Chair of xenopsychiatric medicine|chairman]] of [[Xenopsychiatry|xenopsychiatric]] medicine at the [[Greater Coruscant University]].
